title: Sheafified tensor sections preserve cokernels
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Define $T_X$ on every module $F$ by sheafifying the presheaf $U\mapsto\operatorname{ULift}\Gamma(U,u^*F)$, with the normalized tensor restrictions [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial] and with maps $\varphi\mapsto\Gamma(U,u^*\varphi)$; their naturality is [lem-sc-etale-tensor-sections-map-naturality]. Then $T_X$ preserves colimits of parallel pairs, in particular categorical cokernels. For quasi-coherent $F$, its value is canonically the lifted specified tensor-sections sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module].

source.place: Lemma 35.8.5 (2); see also Tag 03FH (1), and the original additive comparison Step 2

proof.text: Construct the module-variable functor using componentwise tensor-pullback maps; the named naturality theorem supplies its natural-transformation proof. Its identity, composition, and additive laws follow from those of tensor pullback, and its coefficients are lifted before sheafification. The additive law uses the tensor-pullback adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. The unchanged quasi-coherent object comparison uses the specified tensor sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module] and the sheafification isomorphism.

For each module morphism phi form its cokernel short complex S. The local-surjectivity theorem applied to its cokernel projection, followed by Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_presheafToSheaf_map_iff and Sheaf.epi_of_isLocallySurjective, gives an epimorphism (T.map S.g). The middle-exactness theorem gives (S.map T).Exact. Mathlib ShortComplex.Exact.gIsCokernel constructs the mapped cokernel cofork, and CokernelCofork.isColimitMapCoconeEquiv and preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone give preservation of this cokernel.

Infer additivity of the composite from the existing additive tensor-section presheaf functor, the additive ULift functor and additive sheafification. Install the just-proved preservation of each cokernel locally, then apply Mathlib Functor.preservesCoequalizers_of_preservesCokernels.
